title: Tech 09 Search Build Buy
decision: Choose build versus managed search under capability, lock-in, and staffing constraints.
context: A product needs faceted search, typo tolerance, and near-real-time indexing.
Search relevance is important but not the company's core differentiator.
The backend team is already at capacity.
constraints: Launch is required within four months.
Operational on-call headcount cannot increase this year.
The design must preserve a practical migration path away from a vendor.
options: Build and operate an open-source search cluster immediately.
Adopt a managed search service behind an internal abstraction and portable index pipeline.
Delay search until the team can hire dedicated search engineers.

evidence.fact: A prior internal prototype met only basic keyword search after six engineer-weeks and lacked typo tolerance and faceting.
The managed service supports all required launch features and has a documented bulk export API.
Projected managed-service spend at year-one traffic is 7 percent of the product infrastructure budget.
Operating the open-source cluster is estimated to require a rotating primary on-call owner plus quarterly upgrade work.
Product research estimates a six-month launch delay would forgo a contracted design-partner expansion.
The product data model can emit a vendor-neutral canonical search document before indexing.
